Proposed gating (short):
- Phase A (smoke): 100-300 requests/min, baseline latency < 200ms p50, error rate < 0.5% over 30m window.
- Phase B (pilot): 1-2k requests/min, latency p50 < 300ms, p95 < 750ms, no sustained CPU/GPU saturation for 1h.
- Rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 1% for 15m, token generation mismatch rate > 5% vs baseline eval prompts, or any P0 incident.

I attached a suggested rollout schedule (spreadsheet) and a lightweight health-check playbook. We can tighten numbers after we get a short eval run against your sample prompts.

[attachment: Canary_Rollout_Schedule.xlsx (XLSX)]
